name: Job Host Summary Detail
description:
# Retrieve a Job Host Summary:

Make GET request to this resource to retrieve a single job host summary
record containing the following fields:

* `id`: Database ID for this job host summary. (integer)
* `type`: Data type for this job host summary. (choice)
* `url`: URL for this job host summary. (string)
* `related`: Data structure with URLs of related resources. (object)
* `summary_fields`: Data structure with name/description for related resources.  The output for some objects may be limited for performance reasons. (object)
* `created`: Timestamp when this job host summary was created. (datetime)
* `modified`: Timestamp when this job host summary was last modified. (datetime)
* `job`:  (id)
* `host`:  (id)
* `constructed_host`: Only for jobs run against constructed inventories, this links to the host inside the constructed inventory. (id)
* `host_name`:  (string)
* `changed`:  (integer)
* `dark`:  (integer)
* `failures`:  (integer)
* `ok`:  (integer)
* `processed`:  (integer)
* `skipped`:  (integer)
* `failed`:  (boolean)
* `ignored`:  (integer)
* `rescued`:  (integer)
